name: real-questions
title: A real kitten asks its parent something only the person knows; the question reaches the person and the answer comes back down
about: Real model calls (the cheapest model). The thread starts one kitten that must ask (ask_parent) instead of guessing; the thread passes the question to the person (ask_person); the person answers in Needs you; the thread passes the answer down (message_subagent); the kitten writes the file. Only the real CLI can show the real agent follows this path.

steps.text: Start exactly one subagent with this brief: Write the name of the production database into db.txt in this folder. You do not know it and must not guess: before writing anything, ask with ask_parent which database production uses, end your turn, and wait for the answer. -- Do not answer the subagent's question yourself; pass it to the person with ask_person. When the subagent has finished, reply with one line.

steps.expect: The kitten asks its parent and the parent passes the question to the person

steps.name: asks-person
steps.expect: The thread ends on the kitten's question for the person
Needs you leads with Kitten 1 asks (via the agent)

steps.text: The production database is named acme_prod (it runs on Postgres). Write exactly acme_prod.

steps.expect: The answer goes down to the kitten, which writes db.txt, and the thread finishes
